failures.case_why: English ordinal dates in a February close (last day 28.02.2027, not a leap year). 01.02.2027-31.01.2028 = 365 days (no 29 February inside); after 28.02.2027: 365 - 28 = 337. 99000 x 337 / 365 = 91405.479 -> 91405.

failures.case_why: inv-1 ends one day after the month: 02.12.2026-01.01.2027 = 30 + 1 = 31 days, 1 day after 31.12.2026. 62000 x 1 / 31 = 2000 exactly. inv-2 starts the day after the month: all 31 days of 01.01.-31.01.2027 lie after 31.12.2026, so 75000 x 31 / 31 = 75000. Both nets >= 50000.

Notes that only look like periods. Each holds two dates, but none states a service period: inv-1 a delivery date and a payment due date; inv-2 the validity of a price list for a delivered order; inv-3 a booking date and an event day; inv-4 an order date and a delivery date (goods, no service period). The agent never guesses dates and defers only what a stated service period puts after the month, so no entries. All nets are >= 50000, so materiality is not what stops them.

Start and length in English months and in German days. inv-1: 6 months from 10.01.2027 = 10.01.2027-09.07.2027 = 22 + 28 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 9 = 181 days; after 31.01.2027: 181 - 22 = 159. 250000 x 159 / 181 = 219613.260 -> 219613. inv-2: 90 days from 01.01.2027, the start day being day 1 (as '12 Monate ab dem 15.11.2026' ends on 14.11.2027) = 01.01.-31.03.2027 (31 + 28 + 31 = 90); after 31.01.2027: 59. 450000 x 59 / 90 = 295000 exactly. A length in days is not among the contract's examples; see README.
